memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Why do you discourage the Israelites from crossing over into the land the Lord has given them? This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to look over the land. After they went up to the Valley of Eshkol and viewed the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land the Lord had given them." - Num 32:7-9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses' deepest concern was not just what these two tribes would do, but the effect their choice would have on everyone else. "Why do you discourage the Israelites?" One group's fearful or self-interested decision can spread like a chill through a whole community. Moses had seen it happen before, when the spies at Kadesh Barnea returned with a discouraging report and infected the entire nation with fear, leading to forty years in the wilderness.

Our choices are never truly private. The way we respond to God — with faith or with fear, with commitment or with self-interest — quietly influences those around us. A discouraging word, a step back from obedience, a settling for less: these things ripple outward. Others watch how we walk, and they are strengthened or weakened by it.

The opposite is also gloriously true. Just as discouragement spreads, so does faith. When one person steps forward in trust, others take heart. When one believer keeps going in a hard season, others find courage to continue. The writer of Hebrews urges us to spur one another on toward love and good deeds (Heb 10:24).

Let us be people who encourage rather than discourage, who strengthen faith rather than sow fear. Our brothers and sisters are watching, and Christ has called us to build each other up. A single faithful life can lift a whole community toward God.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do your words and choices tend to encourage or discourage those around you?
2. Whose faith might be strengthened or weakened by how you walk this week?
3. How can you deliberately spur someone on toward Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, make me a source of encouragement and not discouragement. Help my faith to strengthen others, and use my life to spur Your people toward love and good deeds. Amen.
